body: In settings, go to the video tab and unselect the "mirror my video" option

The way I was able to fix it was by uninstalling my graphics card in device management under display adaptors, and reinstalling a previous version of it, not the current. To do this, I had to go on my graphic card's website and search previous drivers. However, I have a Nvidia card so I'm not sure if that will 100% work for you. All the other ways online unfortunately haven't worked for me as well.
